column1: # MagicBox fleet — single source of truth.
# One row per box. Columns are TAB-separated. NO IP ADDRESS BELONGS HERE: the
# boxes are on DHCP (cbs_go takes a lease at boot and pins it), and a box must
# be pluggable into another office without touching this repo. Identity is
# `device_id` + `hwaddr`; the address is discovered (LAN) or irrelevant (tunnel).
#   num         Box number (drives the public hostnames box-N / ssh-box-N).
#   tunnel_id   Cloudflare Tunnel UUID for that box (public; also the DNS
#               the credentials JSON it references stays on the box only.
#               reboots, leases and offices; what deploy.sh matches a LAN
#   hwaddr      eth0 MAC (`data.hwaddr`), lower-case. What the ARP table is
#               searched for to find the box on the current LAN.
# Per-box config is rendered from this file by scripts/deploy.sh. Everything
# else (proxy code, systemd units, ingress shape, host hygiene) is identical
# across boxes. Empty device_id/hwaddr ⇒ LAN discovery is skipped for that box
# and the tunnel is used (box-5 was absent from the LAN on 25 Sep 2026).
